questions.question:
After interchanging the given two numbers and two signs what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively? 

× and +, 3 and 9

I. 7 × 9 – 8 ÷ 2 + 3

II. 4 × 9 – 3 + 8 ÷ 2
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

According to the question, after interchanging the given two signs and two numbers i.e :

__
 
• × and +
 
• Two numbers 3 and 9

So,

I. 7 + 3 – **8 ÷ 2**__ × 9

⇒ 7 + 3 - __**4 × 9**__

⇒ __**7 + 3**__ - 36

⇒ __**10 - 36**__

⇒ **-26**

II. 4 + 3 – 9 × __**8 ÷ 2**__

⇒ 4 + 3 - __**9 × 4**__

⇒ __**4 + 3**__ - 36

⇒ __**7 - 36**__

⇒ **-29**

Here, values of equation (I) and (II) are (-26) and (-29) respectively.

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All cards are boxes.

All boxes are torches.

All torches are shoes.

**Conclusions:**

I. All shoes are torches.

II. All torches are boxes.

III. All boxes are cards.

IV. All cards are shoes.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d0bb5d1f71dbb47b1d3f06b6f1e06883ae443e3d34234d9c9689cb1016320e0.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All shoes are torches → **Does not f**ollow (As all torches are shoes. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. All torches are boxes → Does not follow (As all boxes are torches. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

III. All boxes are cards → Does not follow (As all cards are boxes. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

IV. All cards are shoes → **F**ollow (As all cards are boxes, all boxes are torches and all torches are shoes. So, it is definitely true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion IV follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion IV follows**".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

19 : 324 :: 25 : 576 :: 9 : ?
questions.solution:
**Logic : First number = (Square root of second number + 1)**

So,

 
• 19 : 324

​19 = sqrt{324} + 1

19 = 18 + 1

19 = 19 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 
• 25 : 576

25 = sqrt{576} + 1

25 = 24 + 1

25 = 25 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 
• 9 : ?

9 = sqrt{x} + 1

9 - 1 = sqrt{x}

8 = sqrt{x}

x = {8²}

**x = 64**

Hence, **"64"** is the correct answer.

Symbol

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
–

 
 
 
+

to B

 
 
 

So,

 
• Option - (1) : P – Q × R → P is the sister of Q who is the brother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc27c9d139cf4f16eaadd2d2739de1caed4bdd37b90ad476b4a330d4500dfced.png] ​

Here, P is the sister of R.

 
• Option - (2) : P – Q + R → P is the sister of Q who is the father of R.

Here, **P is paternal aunt of R.**

Here, P is the paternal uncle of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48f3762efc599280ce8f3a508e77b13a5fc2f366c6affda1756eced61caa1477.png] ​

Here, P is the father of R.

questions.question: Select the odd group of numbers. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. questions.solution:
**Logic : **

 
• **First number = Cube root of second number **
 
• **Second number - Third number = 10**

So,

 
• Option - (1) : (7 – 343 – 331)

​7 = 3√343

7 = 7 (LHS = RHS)

And, 

**343 - 331 = 12**

 
• Option - (2) : (6 – 216 – 206)

6 = 3√216

6 = 6 (LHS = RHS)

And,

216 - 206 = 10

 
• Option - (3) : (5 – 125 – 115)

5 = 3√125

5 = 5 (LHS = RHS)

And,

125 - 115 = 10

 
• Option - (4) : (3 – 27 – 17)​

3 = 3√27

3 = 3 (LHS = RHS)

And,

27 - 17 = 10

Here, only in option - (1) the difference of the second number and third number is 12 instead of 10. Thus, it is the odd one out.

Hence, **"Option - (1)"** is the correct answer.
